name: Failed payments
summary: Finds failed or overdue member payments in Stripe and Xero, notes each one in Xero, and queues the retry or reminder for a person to approve. Crons read and note; nothing charges or emails a member until approved.

membership-direct-debit.evidence: 0 discovery calls describe this way of handling failed payments; steps come from the platform docs only

appointment-card-on-file.evidence: 0 discovery calls describe this way of handling failed payments; steps come from the platform docs only

crons.name: detect
crons.summary: Find failed Stripe charges and overdue Xero invoices; note each new one in Xero.

crons.name: reconcile
crons.summary: Close failures that have been paid since; note that in Xero. Runs before the chase (21:30 UTC is 7 or 8 am in eastern Australia).

crons.name: chase
crons.summary: Queue the next chase step on each open failure that is due (22:00 UTC is 8 or 9 am in eastern Australia).

draft_ops_note: Draft operations are reads, plus one internal history note per failure in Xero. A note reaches nobody outside the business.

stripe.covers: failed charge detection, retry of the invoice, invoice email for manual payment, paid check

xero.covers: overdue invoice detection, internal history note, reminder email, paid check

gaps: Mindbody: help pages were read, but there is no ops file for it in core/sdk/platforms, so it is not built. Its docs describe automatic card updates only, not failed-charge retries or failed-payment notices.
Square has mapped operations but no failed-payment evidence yet; add it when a client uses it. Fresha has no mapped platform.
Member contact by phone or message, and the member's own card update, are people's steps. No adapter here.
Access hold (pausing bookings or memberships until paid) is not built: it needs the booking platform, and the Stripe subscription update and cancel operations are mapped but not used.
Disputes and chargebacks have mapped Stripe operations but no cron yet.
Xero cannot tell a failed card or direct debit from an unpaid invoice, so an overdue Xero invoice stands in for a failed payment.
Xero is read one page at a time (first 100 authorised invoices). Paging is not built.
A Stripe invoice that also synced into Xero would count twice. Not de-duplicated.
No call evidence and no sandbox run yet: the Stripe test mode and a Xero demo company are needed before this runs for a client.
